0022600209.text: The San Antonio Spurs (8-2, 1st in the Southwest and 2nd in the West) are on an eight-game winning streak and have gone 4-0 on the road as they visit the Phoenix Suns (3-5, 12th in the West), in the Spurs' 11th game of the season. The teams split their 2025-26 season series 2-2 and have not met yet in 2026-27, with the Spurs winning the last meeting 101-100 in San Antonio on March 19, 2026. San Antonio is without Jayden Quaintance (knee, surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf strain), and Devin Vassell is day-to-day with a groin injury and is a game-time decision, while Phoenix is without Jordan Goodwin (calf) and Mark Williams (shoulder, surgery).
